sql: SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name
SELECT 'items_g1' t, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 UNION ALL SELECT 'items_g2', COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'items_g3', COUNT(*) FROM items_g3
SELECT 'items_g1' t, name, type FROM pragma_table_info('items_g1') UNION ALL SELECT 'fdbk_g1', name, type FROM pragma_table_info('fdbk_g1')
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT MIN(prc) mn, MAX(prc) mx, AVG(prc) av, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(prc) cp FROM items_g1
SELECT prc, ttl FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 5

sql: SELECT ROUND(prc*100) = prc*100 AS is_cents_integer_like, COUNT(*) FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND ABS(prc*100 - ROUND(prc*100)) > 1e-6
SELECT prc FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prc ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT prc FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 15
SELECT 'g2' g, MIN(prc) mn, MAX(prc) mx, AVG(prc) av FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', MIN(prc), MAX(prc), AVG(prc) FROM items_g3
SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(prc/100.0 - prc_usd) < 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) matches, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullusd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) reviews, AVG(f.rtg) avg_rtg, MIN(f.rtg) mn, MAX(f.rtg) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls FROM fdbk_g1 f JOIN items_g1 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id WHERE i.prc > 50
SELECT COUNT(*) reviews_total, COUNT(i.ref_id) joined FROM fdbk_g1 f LEFT JOIN items_g1 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN prc>50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) items_gt50, SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN prc>5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) items_gt5000 FROM items_g1
SELECT AVG(i.avg_rtg) avg_item_avgrtg, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 i WHERE i.prc > 50 AND i.avg_rtg IS NOT NULL
